snippet.title: FIRST MONTH of development on my first game! | Prego Wars
snippet.description:
Wishlist Prego Wars: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085060/Prego_Wars/
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ZY7DX958pe

(I actually delivered on the monthly devlog, wow.) To kick off the first month of my sprint to publish my first utterly insane video game Prego Wars in 6-12 months, I went absolutely ham on the codebase. Most of it was written four years ago with no attention to proper design, and it had a chokehold on future development... So I tore it all down and rewrote it.

There are tons of other things I did during the month, including learning how to rig and animate in Blender, export those animations to Unity, upgrading to Unity 6.3, migrating to the new Input System, dueling with the materials system, and getting multiplayer testing ready.

Buckle up because this is going to be an epic ride and we're only just getting started. Burnout? Never heard of him.
